plugins.name: motta-statusline
plugins.description: Two-line status line: folder, repo link, git state, the branch's PR with CI, conflicts and review (toasts when they change), model and effort, a context bar with the auto-compact point, rate limits, tokens and the generation rate. Under the prompt in the CLI, or as a band above it.

plugins.name: assumption-check
plugins.description: A side pane of the assumptions Claude makes, one dropdown per prompt, with counts that filter: mark one right, or wrong (type the fix or let Claude ask), ask why, open its source, or delete it. On from the start, /assumption-check off to stop; nothing in the pane reaches Claude unless you press wrong or why.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: A ✦ enhance chip above the prompt, or /enhance <text>, that opens an Enhance pane and rewrites your draft one of two ways, in one model call: Cleaned up (a cheap model fixes typos, fillers, voice-to-text artifacts and punctuation, nothing else) or Expanded (a short, clear prompt written with the conversation). Use it, send it or copy it; the band holds the chip alone.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time. Vendored from anthropics/claude-code-playground@569c528 (Apache-2.0); opened with /replay only, no band hint.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: IDE-style file tree with git status that shimmers on files Claude reads and writes, and lists those outside its folder. Vendored from data-goblin/claude-code-filetree@bf8de32 (MIT).

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Live agents panel (/agents-info) with each subagent's model, context, cost and time. Vendored from JohnnyVizz/claude-kit@272a877 (MIT).
